name: folio-media
description: Regenerates Folio's icons, social card and README screenshots/GIFs from the running app.

scripts.stills: node capture.js stills hero mobile && THEME=dark node capture.js stills hero mobile && python3 phones.py && python3 optimize.py
scripts.gifs: node capture.js gifs && THEME=dark node capture.js swipe open read quiz
scripts.all: npm run icons && npm run stills && npm run gifs && npm run library
